description: This file defines an abstract class 'FilterField' used for filtering in report generation within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages filter properties and enforces implementation of methods to apply filters to query builders and retrieve entity aliases.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: An abstract class representing a filter field for report query filtering, with properties for ordering and filter values, and abstract methods for applying query modifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes filter properties, including operator, x, y, and order.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to add filtering conditions to the query builder.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve entity aliases involved in the filter.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the filter for sorting purposes.

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Returns the x value of the filter.

methods.name: getY
methods.description: Returns the y value of the filter.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in the filter.

methods.name: modifyX
methods.description: Modifies the x value using a provided callable.

methods.name: modifyY
methods.description: Modifies the y value using a provided callable.
